statement: Historical Linux v6.1 hid-sony DS4 USB/dongle path reads 0x81/7-byte GET_REPORT to recover MAC starting at offset 1; a missing/short response is an error; Bluetooth instead attempts to parse uniq.

applicability.revision: research revisions: Linux 4056b3c, historical Linux v6.1 830b3c6, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e, community 290e4a2; retail revision unknown
applicability.scope: hid-sony.c 505–508, 2598–2638. Historical consumer source, not a universal device-side feature requirement.
